description:
Compress an EPUB file to reduce its size. Can optionally strip unused assets (images, fonts not referenced by any chapter).

Free tier: 5MB/file (10MB for pdf-to-epub, 15MB for split), 3 operations/day, 15 req/min, output includes Epublys branding.
Pro ($9/mo): 30MB per operation, unlimited daily operations, 60 req/min, no branding.

When a call is refused with daily_limited or a Pro-only error, call the `upgrade_to_pro` tool — it returns a checkout link to hand the user. Details: https://epublys.com/pricing

name.description: Original filename — the output is named after its stem (e.g. "Book.epub" gives "Book (compressed).epub"); without it the output keeps a fixed name

stripUnused.description: Remove assets not referenced by any chapter

name: compress_epub
